attributes.action: Make vomit a content warning/trigger warning on movies or series
attributes.additional_details: We need this as many people who have something called "Emetophobia" can be triggered by vomit if they do not have a warning first. It is not just a fear, it is a recognised anxiety disorder which can affect mental health, so without a warning it might worsen if exposed to vomit.
attributes.background: My petition is about adding content warnings and/or trigger warnings on movies/series if vomit is in it, whether that is sound, sight or mentions of it.

rejection.details: This is the responsibility of the producers/distributors, not of the Government
